name: agent-mail-inbox
description: Emit a notification for each new Agent Mail message addressed to $AGENT_NAME in the current project. NOTE: the current backend polls `am check-inbox`, which CONSUMES (marks read) whenever the am daemon is up — without `--direct` it routes through the server's fetch_inbox. Treat the notification as the delivery; do not rely on a later fetch_inbox(unread_only) to re-surface a notified message. A genuinely non-consuming FS-tail backend is tracked in the plugin beads.
